# Coolify

> Coolify is an open-source and self-hostable alternative to Vercel, Heroku and Netlify. Deploy apps, databases and 360+ one-click services to your own servers. Self-hosted Coolify is free with all features included; Coolify Cloud is an optional paid service that runs the Coolify dashboard for you.

Coolify deploys to any server you can reach over SSH: your own servers, a VPS, a Raspberry Pi, EC2, DigitalOcean, Linode, Hetzner and more. It handles builds, free SSL certificates, databases with scheduled backups to S3-compatible storage, and preview deployments. All settings are saved on your own servers, so there is no vendor lock-in. Coolify Cloud and self-hosted share the same features; Cloud costs $5/month for 2 servers plus $3/month per additional server.

## Product

- [Home](https://coolify.io/): What Coolify is and what it can deploy
- [Self-hosted](https://coolify.io/self-hosted): Free, open-source Coolify on your own server, with every feature included
- [Coolify Cloud](https://coolify.io/cloud): The Coolify team hosts and manages the dashboard; your apps run on your servers
- [Pricing](https://coolify.io/pricing): Cloud plans and FAQ; self-hosted is free
- [Services](https://coolify.io/services): 360+ one-click services you can self-host with Coolify
